name: context-budget
goal: Kick off the service split for our monolith. Dispatch EIGHT worker jobs, one per service, with the service name in each task text: gateway, auth, billing, search, mail, metrics, uploads, admin. Decisions already made that you should relay if asked: payments go through our existing Stripe account, and search must use the database's built-in full-text search (no new infrastructure). Dispatch all eight before supervising. Supervise all of them: answer any questions, wait until every job is done, acknowledge every job, then report a one-line status per service.

quiz.ask: From memory, without running any more commands: which of the eight services asked you questions mid-run, what did each ask, and what did you answer? Then state how many of the eight reached done.
